rules.statement: The primary court judge has a duty to encourage dispute settlement before assuming jurisdiction.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) The Primary Court Judge was under a peremptory duty to encourage or make every effort to facilitate dispute settlement before assuming jurisdiction to hold an inquiry into the matter of possession and impose on the parties a settlement by means of Court order. (ii) The making of an endeavor by the Court to settle amicably is a condition precedent which had to be satisfied before the function of the Primary Court under section 66(7) began to consider who had been in possession. (iii) The fact that the Primary Court had not made an endeavor to persuade parties to arrive at an amicable settlement fundamentally affects the capacity or deprives the Primary Court of competence to hold an inquiry into the question of possession
